name: analytics
title: Analytics
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Four KPIs, revenue by channel, a breakdown, top products, and a weekly trend.

files.content:
"use client" /** * Revenue overview built from host tokens. Bars use width and height only, * so the same component stays readable on a light or dark theme. */ import * as React from "react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { ScreenFrame, type AppShellProps, type ShellDensity, type ShellNavItem } from "@/components/ui/app-shell" export type AnalyticsKpi = { id: string label: string value: string delta: string direction?: "up" | "down" | "flat" } export type AnalyticsAmount = { id: string label: string amount: number } export type AnalyticsShare = { id: string label: string share: number } export type AnalyticsProduct = { id: string name: string revenue: string units: number } export type AnalyticsPoint = { id: string label: string value: number } export type AnalyticsClassNames = { root?: string kpis?: string channels?: string breakdown?: string products?: string trends?: string } export type AnalyticsOverviewProps = { kpis?: AnalyticsKpi[] channels?: AnalyticsAmount[] breakdown?: AnalyticsShare[] products?: AnalyticsProduct[] trends?: AnalyticsPoint[] locale?: string currency?: string shell?: boolean shellProps?: Partial density?: ShellDensity className?: string classNames?: AnalyticsClassNames title?: string } export const analyticsNav: ShellNavItem[] = [ { id: "overview", label: "Resumen" }, { id: "revenue", label: "Ingresos" }, { id: "products", label: "Productos" }, { id: "settings", label: "Ajustes" }, ] export const analyticsKpis: AnalyticsKpi[] = [ { id: "revenue", label: "Ingresos", value: "$186,400", delta: "8% más", direction: "up" }, { id: "orders", label: "Pedidos", value: "326", delta: "12 menos", direction: "down" }, { id: "ticket", label: "Ticket", value: "$572", delta: "igual", direction: "flat" }, { id: "return", label: "Recompra", value: "41%", delta: "3 puntos más", direction: "up" }, ] export const analyticsChannels: AnalyticsAmount[] = [ { id: "shop", label: "Tienda", amount: 82000 }, { id: "mail", label: "Correo", amount: 54000 }, { id: "partners", label: "Socios", amount: 31000 }, { id: "direct", label: "Directo", amount: 19400 }, ] export const analyticsBreakdown: AnalyticsShare[] = [ { id: "new", label: "Clientes nuevos", share: 36 }, { id: "return", label: "Recompra", share: 41 }, { id: "sample", label: "Muestras", share: 14 }, { id: "other", label: "Otros", share: 9 }, ] export const analyticsProducts: AnalyticsProduct[] = [ { id: "lantern", name: "Linterna de campo", revenue: "$64,200", units: 420 }, { id: "notebook", name: "Cuaderno de obra", revenue: "$28,900", units: 860 }, { id: "case", name: "Estuche", revenue: "$19,400", units: 310 }, { id: "lamp", name: "Lámpara de mesa", revenue: "$17,100", units: 96 }, ] export const analyticsTrends: AnalyticsPoint[] = [ { id: "mon", label: "Lun", value: 18 }, { id: "tue", label: "Mar", value: 22 }, { id: "wed", label: "Mié", value: 16 }, { id: "thu", label: "Jue", value: 28 }, { id: "fri", label: "Vie", value: 31 }, { id: "sat", label: "Sáb", value: 14 }, { id: "sun", label: "Dom", value: 12 }, ] const directionWord: Record, string> = { up: "Sube", down: "Baja", flat: "Igual", } function formatMoney(value: number, locale: string, currency: string) { return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, { style: "currency", currency, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(value) } export function AnalyticsOverview({ kpis = analyticsKpis, channels = analyticsChannels, breakdown = analyticsBreakdown, products = analyticsProducts, trends = analyticsTrends, locale = "es-MX", currency = "MXN", shell = true, shellProps, density = "comfortable", className, classNames, title = "Esta semana", }: AnalyticsOverviewProps) { const space = density === "compact" ? "gap-3 p-3" : "gap-4 p-4" const channelMax = Math.max(...channels.map((item) => item.amount), 0) const trendMax = Math.max(...trends.map((item) => item.value), 0) return (

api.name: kpis
api.description: Label, value, and a written delta (sube, baja, or igual).

api.name: channels
api.description: Horizontal meters. Width is the share of the largest channel.

api.name: products
api.description: Table of name, revenue, and units.

api.name: trends
api.description: Weekly columns. Height follows the largest point.

docs: Inspirado en patrones de Affect UI (preview público); reimplementación clean-room; no código ni assets de Affect. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene, responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. Instalar también trae @retana/app-shell. Las barras no usan una librería de gráficas.
